answer: Require standing to be earned by serving strangers: each epoch the protocol assigns every identity a few real requests from randomly chosen, non-reciprocal counterparties — prune my walnut data, catalogue this orchard plot, verify an ivory listing — with the requester hidden until delivery. Work inside closed loops, where A serves B who serves A, earns zero, and assignments reshuffle every epoch. A sybil farm gains nothing routing tasks among its own clones; each extra identity must do fresh, useful work for someone outside the farm, so amplification costs as much as honest participation.
